quote.text: Cash in the account beats clever in the funnel. Fund the engine, then floor it.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: One money flag changes the order today. Bank of America fired a low-balance alert at 5:24 AM — the account ending 3001 dropped below $100. Your FB Ads budget is $35/day, so even one day of live spend will overdraw that card and auto-kill delivery. Fund the account first. The Jun 29 ads pull still shows the Lead Gen campaign PAUSED (both ads CAMPAIGN_PAUSED) after $719 of 7-day spend for 194 clicks and zero closes, so do not unpause until cash is in. Then spend the day on the real bottleneck: personal follow-up to the 27+ unbooked GHL leads and manual outbound. No new lead buys while old ones sit uncontacted.
focus: Bank of America flagged the account ending 3001 below $100 at 5:24 AM. At a $35/day budget the card declines within ~2 days and auto-kills ad delivery. Fund the account before you touch the ad campaign — everything else is downstream of cash being there.

The Jun 29 pull still shows the Lead Gen campaign PAUSED with both ads at CAMPAIGN_PAUSED, after $719 in 7-day spend bought 194 clicks and zero closes. Once the account is funded, unpause and confirm delivery before the 8 AM refresh — but not a second before the money lands.

27+ leads at ~$17 CPL and still zero closed means the gap is follow-up, not lead flow. Run a personal call-and-text pass on every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link, starting with anyone who opted in this week.
